adPlacements.label: Header Leaderboard
adPlacements.description: Appears immediately below the main navigation bar across all editorial views.

adPlacements.label: Sidebar Top Spotlight
adPlacements.description: Featured ad or AdsKeeper sidebar widget pinned at the top of the right editorial sidebar.

adPlacements.label: Sidebar Middle Widget
adPlacements.description: Mid-sidebar placement positioned between Recent Posts and Categories.

adPlacements.label: Sidebar Bottom Widget
adPlacements.description: Secondary right-sidebar placement below Categories for AdsKeeper vertical widgets.

adPlacements.label: In-Feed Editorial Banner 1
adPlacements.description: Displays inside the Home, Category, and Search grids after the first 3 story cards.

adPlacements.label: In-Feed Editorial Banner 2
adPlacements.description: Secondary in-feed slot appearing lower in the Home, Category, and Search grids after card 7.

adPlacements.label: Below Stories Feed & Pagination
adPlacements.description: Full-width feed placement directly beneath the stories grid and pagination controls.

adPlacements.label: Above Story Content (Below Featured Image)
adPlacements.description: High-visibility slot directly beneath the featured image and above the first story paragraph.

adPlacements.label: Article Inline Callout 1 (~25%)
adPlacements.description: First in-article slot (~25% through stories with 10+ blocks), placed strictly between paragraphs.

adPlacements.label: Article Inline Callout 2 (~60%)
adPlacements.description: Second in-article slot (~60% through stories with 20+ blocks). Assign a separate AdsKeeper widget ID.

adPlacements.label: Article Inline Callout 3 (~80%)
adPlacements.description: Third in-article slot near the lower section (~80%) of longer stories with 24+ blocks.

adPlacements.label: Below Article Recommendations
adPlacements.description: High-visibility zone directly beneath full articles — ideal for AdsKeeper recommendation grids.

adPlacements.label: Pre-Footer Banner
adPlacements.description: Wide placement spanning the bottom of the page just above the dark site footer.

adPlacements.label: Floating Bottom Sticky Bar
adPlacements.description: Pinned floating banner anchored at the bottom of the screen with a reader dismiss button.

adPlacements.label: Ads Notification (Corner Popup)
adPlacements.description: Push-style sponsored notification popup anchored at the bottom-right corner with a dismiss button (Direct Sponsor or AdsKeeper).
